title: The 3 programming paradigms that AI cannot replace

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The "the" is clear—AI can't replace the paradigm of formal logic, which underpins all rigorous software verification. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But AI can model and optimize protocols, like TCP/IP, which require adaptive decision-making beyond rigid rules. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Formal logic isn't rigid—it's the foundation of Z3 and Coq, tools that AI can't replicate for proving correctness in code. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: AI excels in pattern recognition, essential for dynamic protocols like blockchain consensus, which evolve with usage. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future is adaptive, not static—AI defines the 3 paradigms that will shape tomorrow’s tech. (4 sec)
